Phoned around 11am to set up two non-urgent appointments for a date in the future (i.e. not needing to be seen that day).

I then had to ask if it was at all possible to book an appointment for any time in the future. For example, any time from tomorrow to a month out. Only then did they (it felt like) begrudgingly offer an appointment for a few days time.
I had two things to talk about, but was only offered one appointment for one of my issues. I guess I need to phone a second time to book a second appointment.

It feels like the phone staff have been given instructions to make efforts to avoid having people make appointments. At every point of the process they are only reacting to my requests, and never pro-actively suggest solutions. After years of being in pain and suffering from a variety of debilitating symptoms, I "cut off from any future testing" I went to a different GP within the surgery and after more years of pushing for answers I found that I have Endometriosis alongside some other chronic health issues- I was not referred to appropriate services due to my pain being blamed on my mental health (its unsurprising that my mental health suffered after years of medical negligence and gaslighting) it has taken me 19 years to find answers due to their lack of care and my quality of life and trust in the health care system has suffered substantially. They refused to treat my underactive thyroid, symptoms of hypermobility or any other health issues that I was experiencing until I brought in an advocacy worker. Whilst this helped, it shouldn't have been necessary and as soon as the advocacy worker discharged me, I was back to being dismissed and having my health issues ignored which is why I finally decided to move. This has had a huge impact on my mental and physical health. The reception staff, particularly the practice manager are rude and condescending. I am annoyed at myself that I put up with this treatment for so long, including being laughed at by the practice manager down the phone when I was distressed. The list of ways in which this surgery has let me down is too lengthy to note down. I put in a complaint but they didn't even have the courtesy to address my issues and suggested that I take it to the Ombudsman. I stayed in the hope things would get bet- things only got worse.
